description:
Location: Bucharest, Romania 
 
 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 
   
 In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more. 
 
 
 About the project 
 Within the Engineering cluster, the Naval business unit is collaborating within the Thales group on the development of combat and information management systems for navy ships, integration with sensor- and weapon systems as well as the development of sensor processing applications. These complex systems contain advanced solutions for information processing, information management and the user interaction with both sensor- and weapon systems. Our product, called TACTICOS, offers essential support for missions varying from anti-piracy to ballistic missile defense.
 
 About the job 
 We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help us develop and maintain various software products/functionalities in the area of Combat Management and Sensors Systems.
 You will be part of a multidisciplinary and self-managing Agile team located in our premises in Bucharest
 Our Naval teams develop and test applications, features and/or components the software platform for the Tacticos combat management system, the radar systems and the sensor systems;
 Cybersecurity is an integral part of the whole process;
 Thales highly values the application of modern technologies and methodologies;
 
 About you 
 Do you have a passion for technology, do you enjoy constantly developing your skills and are you interested in working on Naval Command & Control systems? Then you are the person we are looking for.
 You are a talented Software Engineer, with   minimum 4 years of relevant experience (in Linux) using one of the technologies: C/C++ and wilingness to improve your knowledge
 You have the ability to collaborate on projects and work independently when required
 With every design decision you take, security is the first thing you consider. Relevant technologies that   you will use in your activities include: Linux, Jenkins, Bitbuket/Git, Podman/Docker; 
 Knowledge of the Linux operating system (in particular RHEL6 - 8) is highly appreciated;
 
 Nice to have: 
 Observability : Ansible, Linux, QT, Kubernetes, ELK stack 
 Window Management:   Ansible 
 System Thinking
 Python or Java
 
 YOUR CAREER AT THALES 
 Joining Thales, you will integrate into a tight-knit team working in an international and friendly environment. Thanks to various teams working on multiple fields and domains, all located in Bucharest, you will be able to evolve and grow your competences in different areas.
 Room for and attention to personal development

 The opportunity to grow within the organisation, for instance on a technical, managerial or international level, within the various markets Thales is working in

 
 YOUR IMMEDIATE BENEFITS 
 24 holiday days a year
 Benefit Online
 A good work-life balance which includes flexible working hours
 A comprehensive compensation and benefit package including medical coverage & life insurance
 Hybrid Workplace
 Coursera and goFLUENT Subscription
 
 
 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
